snippet.title: Kingdom: Two Crowns 10th Rulerversary Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
Gather coins, build defenses and reclaim your fallen Kingdom. Explore and uncover secrets, unlock new technologies and protect your crown versus waves of Greed monsters that come at night. Kingdom Two Crowns is a solo or co-op micro-strategy and tower defense game set in an atmospheric pixel world. For PATCH 2.3 it's the 10th RULERVERSARY MAJOR UPDATE:
The Kingdom game series is celebrating a decade in the making! We invite our players to celebrate with us in this free major update to the game. As revealed in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/701160
